description: Pages built from AI defaults: generated by common site builders and AI app builders without a brand, plus the kit's own unguided baseline outputs. A taste rule's hit rate is how often it fires here. Informational: only the hand-made false-alarm rate gates the audit.
method: Entries with a url are loaded like the hand-made set; entries with a file are local HTML (for example a page from an unguided evals run, copied into pages/). Add about 30, each with why it belongs.
